title.narrative: Enhancing Monitoring and Inspection Transparent Transformation for Emission Reduction (EMITTER)

description.narrative: The project aims to improve the environmental management in Ukraine through better regulation, more efficient monitoring and control system based on open data usage; to enhance civil engagement (CE) by means of establishing a permanent dialogue between citizens (represented by civil society organizations (CSOs) and government at different levels for more inclusive and effective policies.Objectives(1) Reduction of industrial air pollution through better environmental regulation and National Emissions Reduction Plan for Large Combustion Plants (NERP) implementation(2) Enhancing public environmental control through better regulation within the State Environmental Inspectorate of Ukraine (SEIU)(3) Raising local, national and international environmental transparency of Ukraine in terms of pollutant release levels(4) Increase transparency and accountability of environmental services (constructions, waste transportation, etc) by creating set of digital products with open data publication and CSO monitoring tools(5) Building a strong stakeholder coalition around better regulation practices among civil society, local and national authorities and business
